problem_statement: When iterating through previously saved frames of a buffered multi-frame queue, if the buffer is cleared while an iteration is in progress, the iteration incorrectly reports that there are no more frames instead of aborting, and any frame saved after the clear is not delivered. The iteration must abort when the buffer is cleared mid-iteration (resetting the frame pointer and length to empty, preserving the newly saved frame) and must then restart from a fresh iteration so the newly saved frame is read and the queue is then drained.
oracle_note: observed by validate_instance.py (fail before, pass after the fix); the unit oracle is per executable, so check attribution of the cases to the PR's change
